zh: 随插件发布的聊天宠物从 Cindy 一只扩为整套岛屿伙伴：新增 Annie、Black Cat、Boli、Chaku、Erika、Muffin、Tarara 与 Apple Girl 的原画（Apache-2.0），仍在设置页同一处选择，状态与手势与 Petdex 宠物一致。
en: Grow the shipped chat pets from Cindy alone to the whole island set: Annie, Black Cat, Boli, Chaku, Erika, Muffin, Tarara and Apple Girl join her (Apache-2.0), picked from the same settings row, keeping the same states and gestures a Petdex pet answers.
